english.title: Person in charge of wind turbine generator fail to ensure light displayed
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person in charge of a wind turbine generator at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to ensure that by night, a light required to be fitted by article 223 of the Air Navigation Order 2016, was displayed
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 223(6) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016
